title: Band-Limited White Noise
text: Introduce white noise into continuous system, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Seed} sets Starting seed; {Noise power} sets the height of PSD of white noise, {Sample time} sets the correlation time of noise and {Interpret vector parameters as 1-D} treats vector parameters as 1-D. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Normally distributed random numbers scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Correlation time of noise 0.1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.values: Starting seed [23341] (default) | scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array
